owner_requirements: gb_feedback_0910/0930/0950: preregister v0.0.20 with ONE changed lever (bigger model or more self-play games; pick and justify); land via PR before the run; tag only on a real pass; nice 19, loadavg < 86
question: Do two-player self-play games, seeded from v0.0.19 and trained on the match outcome alone, produce a champion that beats the frozen v0.0.19 with real hits?
lever: ONE change from v0.0.19: the training games. Solo motor trials vs a frozen posture (stand + hit-and-stay-up fitness) -> two-player self-play league games (zero-sum match utility only). Model class, initialisation (v0.0.19 final_params), ES step sizes, reset, ending (v2, anti-stalling) unchanged. Justification: grokbot/redteam/cycle-0026.md (the model now passes the motor gate; the remaining failure, balance wins without knockdowns, only appears against an opponent; v0.0.19 plays 100% valid games, so the league finally has an outcome signal).
classification: grokbot diagnostic league with frozen anchors; not an unassisted boxing result; jekko's completion battery not claimed

league.training_terms: match utility only: shaping_weight 0, strike_bonus 0, valid_bonus 0, no_contest_penalty 0
league.opponent_sampling: P4 mixture (latest, PFSP history, anchors = scripted panel + frozen anchors), eps 0.1
league.promotion: grokbot.promotion.decide against the current champion, GateConfig(min_valid=12, min_engaged_share=0.25)
league.require_valid: True (DegenerateLeagueError aborts a league with an all-invalid evaluation batch)

candidate: the league's final champion (report['champion']); if no generation is promoted the champion is gen0 = v0.0.19 itself

primary.name: a/b/c gate vs the frozen v0.0.19 on NEW seeds

head_to_head.env: grokbot.reference_env.ReferenceEndingEnv(RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000), anti_stalling=True) via grokbot.selfplay.play_game (ending v2, unchanged)
head_to_head.candidate: the v0.0.20 league champion (kind group_pd), eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.opponent: frozen v0.0.19: kind group_pd, v0.0.19 final_params, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.sides: each seed with the candidate in corner A and in corner B (48 games)
head_to_head.valid: grokbot.selfplay.valid_result; every game stays in the denominator
head_to_head.elo: Elo = 400*log10(p/(1-p)) with p = (1+mean)/2 clipped to [0.5/n, 1-0.5/n]; Elo lower bound from p_low = (1+lower95)/2 (-inf if p_low <= 0); win rate with a Wilson 95% interval (descriptive)
head_to_head.pass: ALL of: (a) valid games >= 50% of the 48; (b) lower95 > 0 (Elo lower bound > 0); (c) at least half of the candidate's valid wins include >= 1 candidate head/torso hit

primary.level_up: v0.0.20 is a level-up (tagged v0.0.20) iff this primary passes: (a) valid >= 50% of 48 AND (b) lower95 > 0 AND (c) >= half of the candidate's valid wins with >= 1 candidate head/torso hit

secondary_reported_not_gating.vs_v0016: champion vs frozen v0.0.16 on seeds 8000-8023 (48 games), same statistics
secondary_reported_not_gating.vs_v0013: champion vs frozen v0.0.13 on seeds 8000-8023 (48 games), same statistics
secondary_reported_not_gating.final_generation: if the champion is not the last generation, the last generation vs frozen v0.0.19 on the primary seeds
secondary_reported_not_gating.motor_gate: champion on the 24 motor-gate seeds vs frozen gen4 (stance, reach, hits, median stand)
secondary_reported_not_gating.league: per-generation Elo, side balance, valid share, engaged share, promotions, training valid share

red_team_notes: If no generation is promoted, the primary compares v0.0.19 with itself and is expected to fail (b); that is an honest null, not a pass
Under anti-stalling the first fall loses, so a league can drift to pure balance; criterion (c) keeps a balance-only champion from passing
No head-to-head has been played on seeds 7000-7023 or 8000-8023, nor league eval seeds 100-111
pre_declared_readings: primary passes: self-play games improved the policy against its own starting point with hits; tag v0.0.20; next preregister a longer league (more generations)
a promoted champion fails (c): the league learned balance, not hitting; next lever: hit-aware training term or knockdown-only endings
no promotion / (b) fails: the outcome signal from 4x4x24 games is too weak; next lever: more games per generation
DegenerateLeagueError: some evaluation batch had 0 valid games; report the census, no claim
